anti_js.evidence: Python runner only; no node/js tooling invoked.

attribution.residualization_method: Iterative additive fixed-effect demeaning of both risk_intensity and PnL. Groups with fewer than two observations are not demeaned to avoid zeroing singleton ticker trades.

calibration.surprise_note: The residual relationship survived stronger controls than expected, but it remains a non-promoted lead.

target_price.reason: This observed-only closed-trade attribution consumes no candidate/order target_price and changes no trading rule.

gate3.note: No new filter was added; this is closed-trade attribution only.

lead_limitations: The field is endogenous to the already accepted sizing stack.
Promotion would require a shared daily/forward attribution surface and closed rows.
gate4.reason: Observed-only residual attribution; before and after policy are identical.

hypothesis: Observed-only deconfounding: if current core risk intensity is a real alpha attribution surface, the positive PnL relation should survive residualizing by window, ticker, sector, entry strategy, and applied multiplier-family buckets before any future sizing policy is considered.
new_evidence_axis: Residualized attribution of the positive exp-20260622-019 risk-intensity lead; no scalar, filter, ranking, entry, exit, or production behavior change.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not convert this result into a historical risk scalar, top-up, cap, or multiplier sweep on the same windows. A scalar promotion would be a different policy and would confound endogenous accepted-stack attribution with new alpha.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A valid promotion path needs a shared default-off daily ledger or forward attribution surface that records pre-execution risk-intensity rank, then enough closed rows to test whether incremental sizing or ranking improves EV without worse drawdown or concentration.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Risk intensity retained positive residual association with realized PnL after additive controls for window, ticker, sector, strategy, and multiplier-family buckets. This is still observed-only because it is endogenous to the accepted sizing stack and no after-policy was tested.

past_near_experiments.important_boundary: This is a deconfounding attribution of exp-20260622-019, not a scalar, top-up, rank, entry, or exit retry.

pre_run_questions.profit_hypothesis: If risk intensity is more than a label for winning tickers or windows, residualized risk intensity should still track residualized realized PnL.
pre_run_questions.single_policy_bundle: Accepted core closed trades plus residualized risk-intensity attribution; no rule, threshold, ranking, entry, exit, or sizing behavior changed.
pre_run_questions.success_failure_standard: Observed-only lead only if residualized risk_intensity has positive pooled Spearman with residual PnL, at least two of three window residual Spearman values are positive, and the high residual-intensity tertile beats low on residual mean and median PnL.

prediction.confidence_reason: exp-20260622-019 found strong raw monotonicity, but prior risk scalar/topup retunes were fragile and the relation may simply identify existing winning tickers or multiplier labels rather than a new deployable decision variable.

production_impact.live_realistic_execution_envelope: Not evaluated; this is observed-only attribution, not a live-ready strategy.
